name: Spotify Highest Quality
author: dnlsndr
summary: Selects the Spotify DJ SDK quality level, safely.
description:
Adds a Mod Menu choice row for Spotify quality: Deck default, Fastest (0) or Default (5). Deck default leaves EP147's value untouched. The DJAudioQuality level 8 (Highest) crashed EP147 when a Spotify track was loaded, so it is not offered. The log prints the deck's own value on the first add_track call.

This is still the deck's Spotify integration; it is not Spotify Lossless/FLAC. The hardware eSDK's playback bitrate API has no lossless setting.
